excluded_qc_holds.title: #1354: Backspace in Effect Controls removes the selected effect, not the clip
excluded_qc_holds.reason: Current unresolved Major inline review says Effect Controls Backspace falls through to edit.clear when no effect/mask is selected, including a second press after removal, so the user can delete a selected clip. No later review/resolution in supplied evidence.

excluded_qc_holds.title: fix(interchange): FCP7 import stops at the engine's 999 tracks of a kind
excluded_qc_holds.reason: Current reviewDecision remains CHANGES_REQUESTED. Unresolved Major inline review identifies FCP7 overlap placement calling Builder::place without enforcing MAX_TRACKS; an overlap at XML track index 998 can create track 1000 despite the 999 cap. Separate unresolved link-bookkeeping data-integrity concern also remains.

excluded_qc_holds.title: graphics: typing into a title on Linux input methods no longer stops working
excluded_qc_holds.reason: Unresolved Major inline review identifies IME hold expiration on a delayed key-up: if release arrives after the hold interval, the interval is already elapsed and IME is disabled immediately, defeating the intended release grace period.

excluded_qc_holds.title: Keep literal < and > text in TTML/DFXP export
excluded_qc_holds.reason: Current reviewDecision remains CHANGES_REQUESTED. Two unresolved TTML parser findings: `>` inside a quoted attribute can terminate a tag early and lose markup; trimming whitespace after `<` can parse literal `< b >` as markup and drop user text.

excluded_qc_holds.title: Fix Ripple Delete playhead position
excluded_qc_holds.reason: Unresolved current-head review says selected-gap Ripple Delete closes the gap but bypasses the playhead update, leaving the playhead inside the deleted interval. This misses the named behavior of the PR.

excluded_qc_holds.title: Fix for the Timeline Issue where "On first drag, it Stutters"
excluded_qc_holds.reason: Unresolved Critical inline review says the scrub callback is wrapped in Arc<Mutex<_>> before platform cfg branching and wrapped again in the non-macOS worker path, yielding Arc<Mutex<Arc<Mutex<Fill>>>> where output.open requires Arc<Mutex<Fill>>. This is a cross-platform compile blocker.

excluded_qc_holds.title: TTML/DFXP XML whitespace preservation
excluded_qc_holds.reason:
Although FredApps approved this exact head after the bot note, the unresolved TTML parser thread identifies round-trip loss: `clean` trims leading/trailing XML whitespace represented by `
`, and `str::lines()` drops a final break. This is a caption content fidelity defect in the PR’s touched parser.

excluded_qc_holds.title: Audio effects recover from one NaN or infinity sample
excluded_qc_holds.reason: Although FredApps approved this exact head after the bot note, the unresolved STFT thread identifies cross-channel contamination: a non-finite input in either channel enters the packed complex FFT and spreads NaN/Inf into both split spectra, poisoning the clean neighboring channel. This contradicts the PR’s stated single-sample recovery behavior and regresses prior per-channel isolation.
